eligibility_note: Own panel least squares estimation; exposure is internet users (and secure internet servers); 45 SSA countries stated (34 cross-sections, 598 obs in Table 5), above 10; outcome is financial inclusion (family 5). Internet being one of several regressors does not disqualify it because it is a reported exposure coefficient. Eligible but weak (pooled, no identification).
income_group_note: No income-group results reported; record's 'not reported' entries are correct.

risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: pooled OLS with causal wording ('positively enhance'), no strategy for reverse causation.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: internet users unit not stated, servers a weak proxy.
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: 45 countries stated but 34 cross-sections and 598 unbalanced obs used, unexplained.
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: agree: AFII/FII/FIIM labels inconsistent across tables and text.
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: unit roots found but levels pooled regression; no fixed effects; R-squared printed as 1436; Durbin-Watson 0.12.
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: single specification, little to judge; abstract promises three-period results that are not reported.
risk_of_bias.why: Causal language with a pooled levels regression, no effects, no strategy for endogeneity; serious fits.

problems: Record minor: unit of USERS ambiguous (Table 2 mean 11.183 suggests per 100). Abstract lists three periods but no period-specific results; the record notes this. Nothing invented or mixed up.
